title: af.seal-ignored/1
description: What sealing left out of a candidate (ADR-0198): the paths a Worker added that the project's ignore rules exclude, read from the sealed tree (the kernel defaults `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`, `/target/` and `node_modules/`, every `.gitignore`, then `.af/seal-ignore`; a `!` rule stages a path back). A path the parent Snapshot held is never left out. Referenced from the `af/CandidateTree@1` envelope beside its Manifest, and recorded only when something was left out. `ignored` names at most 1000 paths, sorted; `ignored_count` is the whole number.
